info.name: Notes API - Automated Tests
info.description: Postman collection for testing the Notes REST API specification. Run the requests in order using the Collection Runner. The collection stores noteId and attachmentId automatically from successful create responses. Before running the attachment upload request, select a local file for the form-data field named 'file'.

request.description: Retrieves all notes. An empty data set must be returned as an empty JSON array.

exec: pm.test('Updating missing note returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

request.description: Select a local test file for the form-data field named 'file' before running this request. Do not manually set Content-Type; Postman will add the multipart boundary.

item.name: 11 - Get all notes includes attachment data

exec: pm.test('Uploading to a missing note returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

request.description: Uses the same selected-file requirement as the successful upload test.
